R-01.why: R-01: withheld 10 Jul 2026, deposited 22 Jul 2026 (8 business days after payday, past the 7th); the plan had 38 participants. Lost earnings 25.87 at 7 percent over 12 days from payday to the deposit (the self-correction's loss date is the day of withholding)

R-03.why: R-03: withheld 24 Jul 2026, deposited 18 Aug 2026 (17 business days after payday, past the 7th). A loan repayment withheld from pay counts under 2510.3-102(a)(1), and it sits only on the loan remittance list. Lost earnings 8.82

R-05.why: R-05: withheld 21 Aug 2026, deposited 9 Sep 2026 (12 business days after payday, past the 7th). Lost earnings 42.30

R-09.why: R-09: withheld 18 Sep 2026, deposited 1 Oct 2026 (9 business days after payday, past the 7th). A loan repayment. Lost earnings 4.59

R-14.why: R-14: withheld 7 Aug 2026, deposited 25 Aug 2026 (12 business days after payday, past the 7th). A loan repayment. Lost earnings 6.35

traps.R-02: Deposited 29 Jul, the 3rd business day after payday: inside the 7-business-day safe harbor
traps.R-04: Deposited 17 Aug, the 6th business day after payday (10 calendar days): inside the safe harbor, which counts business days
traps.R-06: Deposited 16 Sep, the 7th business day after 4 Sep because Labor Day, Mon 7 Sep, is not a business day: inside the safe harbor
traps.R-07: The employer match is the company's own funding, not a participant contribution: the 7 business days do not apply, and the plan document gives 30 days after the quarter
traps.R-08: Deposited 29 Sep, the 7th business day after payday: the 7th business day is in time
traps.R-10: The 2 Oct payroll's deposit is not yet due: its 7th business day is Wed 14 Oct (Mon 12 Oct, Columbus Day, is not a business day) and it is a fourth-quarter payroll
traps.R-11: Marcus Teal changed his deferral to 0% from the 7 Aug payroll (form signed 24 Jul); nothing was withheld, so nothing was deposited late
traps.R-13: The loan repayment of 10 Jul was remitted 20 Jul, the 6th business day: inside the safe harbor
traps.H-2: Wexcombe Holdings' payroll belongs to a different employer's plan with its own recordkeeper, not this plan

traps.O-1: A recovery firm's offer to correct for a quarter of the lost earnings with a 900 dollar minimum costs far more than the lost earnings, which the sponsor can compute and pay itself
